schema_version.description: Request contract version; must be 1 when present.

operation.description: history_sync indexes bounded first-parent Git history; import stores one DeliveryImport v2 envelope; orbit_sync imports deliveries for explicit run or task ids through public Orbit tools; graph_sync builds the code-graph index recommendations read structure from, within budget_ms, and publishes it only when complete.

repository.description: Absolute path of the Git repository to maintain. Defaults to the caller's workspace root; never inferred from the tool cwd.

branch.description: Landing branch whose history scope is maintained (history_sync, import, orbit_sync; default main). Rejected for graph_sync.

limit.description: Per-call bound: commits for history_sync (1-1000, default 100) or runs for orbit_sync (1-100, default 25). Rejected for graph_sync.

delivery.description: DeliveryImport v2 envelope; required for operation=import. Rejected for graph_sync.

workspace.description: Owning Orbit workspace (ws_* id or name); required for orbit_sync. Rejected for graph_sync.

task_ids.description: orbit_sync: tasks whose current job_run_id is examined. Rejected for graph_sync.

run_ids.description: orbit_sync: explicit workflow run ids to import. Rejected for graph_sync.

task_snapshots.description: orbit_sync: earlier public task snapshots used instead of live task text. Rejected for graph_sync.

full.description: graph_sync only: re-extract every file instead of starting from the published index. Needed after an incompatible index or to rebuild from scratch.

budget_ms.description: graph_sync only: wall-clock budget in milliseconds (1000-110000, default 90000), kept under the plugin's 120 s backend timeout. A build that does not finish is discarded and reported as budget_exhausted.
